Which residual monomer is to be followed, over what concentration range, and what detection limit and accuracy are required? Butyl acrylate, roughly 0.5 to 8 wt% during the feed; our lab reference is GC.
Are fluorescent species present in the formulation, such as surfactants, initiators, stabilisers or optical brighteners? No optical brighteners; an anionic surfactant and a persulfate initiator are used.
